name: indaga-mods
description: Claude Code mods by IndagaLab: panes, guards and toasts.

plugins.name: music-pane
plugins.description: A music player beside the chat: your albums and YouTube, a search by title, singer or a line of the lyrics, similar songs after each one, the cover, a progress bar and the lyric line being sung. /music opens it.

plugins.name: mail-pane
plugins.description: Your latest mail beside the chat, through the Microsoft 365 connector: read each mail and its attachments in the pane, save them to a folder and pass them to the chat to work on, with a toast when new mail comes in. /mail opens it.

plugins.name: review-pane
plugins.description: Your pull requests and merge requests beside the chat: the GitHub and GitLab ones that wait for your review, yours and the ones you take part in, or every one of a project you pick, with their checks, a toast when someone asks for your review, and one press to review one in the chat. /reviews opens it.
